description: Inline Dock layout snapshot stored in a workspace entity's dock-layout property. Serialized in one pass by System.Text.Json with ReferenceHandler.Preserve (#1335), so collections are emitted as {"$id","$values":[...]} wrappers and back-references as {"$ref"}. Legacy Dock.Serializer snapshots (plain arrays, no reference metadata) also validate. A null or structurally invalid object causes the workspace to fall back to default layout.

$id.description: ReferenceHandler.Preserve identity of the root dock container.

Id.description: Stable identifier for the root dock container.

dockable-collection.description: A list of dockables, either as a plain JSON array (legacy Dock.Serializer format) or as a ReferenceHandler.Preserve wrapper object carrying $id and $values.

dockable-ref.description: A reference to a dockable, either inline (carrying its Id) or a ReferenceHandler.Preserve back-reference ($ref).

dockable.description: A single dockable item — a WorkspaceDocument (leaf), a nested dock (split/proportional), or a ReferenceHandler.Preserve back-reference ($ref).

Id.description: Must match the tab-id of the corresponding workspace-tab-descriptor in the tabs array.

Proportion.description: Fractional width/height in a split. Dock serialises double.NaN as the string "NaN".
